notes: The initial before-layout binary was reused from the prior run and has a modified working-tree build marker; its base revision is not an exact source snapshot.
The million-event ingestion report is reused from November 8; it is not new ingestion throughput with projections.
Fresh ingestion after migrations used 100000 unique events and 10000 replays.
Fresh ingestion has no overlapping CPU/RSS sampler records; first sample is 6.341 seconds after intake ended.
API outcomes are authoritative. Query-log groups can omit entries; their totals need not match task counts.
First-observed is not cold cache. Successful-sample percentiles exclude failed attempts, which remain in outcome totals.
Query latency includes job queueing and bounded polling.
Parts, caches and server allocation state are not frozen across measurements.
No native JSON property migration or per-property reader was delivered.
No ten-million-user capacity claim is supported by these synthetic measurements.
